scope: Persistent application goal/route contract and corrected chassis rendering. Not proof of globally optimal tactics or a matched survival/win-rate improvement.
actual_progress: Completed route waypoints must improve best remaining distance, or actual enemy HP/shield loss must occur; mere back-and-forth position changes are not goal progress. Forecast worlds do not update the actual progress sensor.

runtime_checks.initial_rejection_scope: Rejected before model forward under the existing 512-token complete-path cap. Not retried unchanged. Repeated prose was rewritten as a compact explicit contract; no truncation or raised limits.
runtime_checks.live_configuration: intent-live-check, synchronous, friendly-fire, each checkpoint vs search-baseline, two controller decisions per side. The second own decision continued both tanks' approved routes without a model call or rollout. Goals and routes were initially planned once per tank.
runtime_checks.quality_boundary: Short bounded integration runs, not full combat-quality comparisons. The two model services were already loaded. No broad speed, win-rate or optimality conclusion is drawn.

rendering: Tracks now run along the chassis forward axis and rotate with the hull based on actual movement history. Turret aim is independent; health bars and IDs remain upright. Desktop and mobile canvas screenshots checked. Collision geometry and ballistics are unchanged.

external_sources.title: Jeff Orkin — Agent Architecture Considerations for Real-Time Planning in Games (AIIDE 2005)
external_sources.use: Separate goal memory, action execution and event-driven invalidation; no copied code.

external_sources.title: Stephen Boyd — Model Predictive Control, Stanford EE364b
external_sources.use: Distinguish executed first actions and future forecasts; no transfer of linear/convex stability guarantees to the game.

external_sources.title: RoboWiki — Linear Targeting
external_sources.use: Reviewed aiming/flight-time assumptions; lead aiming is not implemented in this revision.

privacy: Public synthetic aggregate only; full local match receipts remain private. Historical v3 research was not relabeled as v4 evidence.
